# Plotly dependency

`plotly-gl3d-3.1.0.min.js` is the unmodified Plotly.js gl3d distribution downloaded
from https://cdn.plot.ly/plotly-gl3d-3.1.0.min.js on 3 October 2026.

It is pinned for the application terrain renderer. The file retains its copyright header. The corresponding MIT license
from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/plotly/plotly.js/v3.1.0/LICENSE is included
as `plotly-LICENSE.txt`.

SHA-256 of the distributed bundle:
`17df71fcd0e31dd278c2f8bc6e890b4b037426502a3c8f82dc27c9f871592f14`.
